## What changed

Describe the user, protocol, or documentation change.

## Why

Explain the problem and any privacy, value, or workflow implications.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Focused tests were added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] Visual changes include relevant screenshots and responsive checks

## Safety and documentation

- [ ] No secrets, viewing material, decrypted notes, or plaintext production recipient data are included
- [ ] Public and private claims remain accurate
- [ ] State-changing flows guard duplicate submission and completed states are terminal
- [ ] Contract addresses, environment variables, migrations, and deployment assumptions are documented when changed
- [ ] User-facing or architectural behavior is reflected in the relevant `docs/` page
